subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw merge this PR's operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect drain as the canonical fix for QQBot reconnect outbound loss?
rationale: The implementation looks correct, but it changes compatibility-sensitive plugin resolution order and queued message replay behavior across core outbound and QQBot lifecycle boundaries, which automation should not accept without owner intent.

options.title: Approve Resolver And Drain
options.body: Merge after outbound/QQBot owners accept the operation-aware resolver semantics and reconnect replay behavior, with merge-ref CI gating the current base.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask the author to reduce the change to only the owner-approved delivery paths or split resolver and QQBot drain work if owners want smaller review units.

options.title: Pause For Alternate Fix
options.body: Close or pause this PR only if maintainers prefer a different reconnect repair such as a targeted bootstrap-state reset plus separate queue-recovery work.

recommendation.title: Approve Resolver And Drain
recommendation.body: Merge after outbound/QQBot owners accept the operation-aware resolver semantics and reconnect replay behavior, with merge-ref CI gating the current base.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent central outbound and gateway delivery history, which is the broader compatibility-sensitive surface beyond QQBot itself.
